tips.text: Mercy every Duet right away, even with the wrong mods; a Duet left standing blocks your squadmates' Coda from spawning.
Run the Antivirus Bounty between every stab so one run makes Antivirus mods and disinfection progress together.
Run the Concert in a full public squad; each squadmate who beats their own Coda adds one Heartcell, up to three.
Slot Quick Correct as one of your two Potency mods; each stab has a 10% chance of a bonus Heartcell for the whole squad.
Abort right after a successful stab; the progress banks, but Potency side-drops like Heartcells are lost.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields and melts shield-gating builds.
Skip Tank Assassination, Stage Defense and Faceoff; a Coda cannot spawn there.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for more Hex standing per run.
Buy any roll of 52.8% or better, and buy low rolls too if you are patient; fusion keeps the higher number.
Don't wait for a better element; Elemental Vice swaps it, so only the percentage matters.
Expect a full Coda cycle to cost a fraction of a Kuva Lich; players hold it up as the model adversary system.
Players regret buying a low roll without counting the five Forma and the Vice cost of making its element usable.
